turns.content: Predict product A from Sharpless asymmetric epoxidation of (Z)-hex-2-en-1-ol with t-BuOOH, Ti(O-i-Pr)4, and (-)-DET. Give its structure or name and assign the oxirane stereocenters, noting the reported enantiomeric excess above 80%.
Oxidize A with PDC to obtain B. Identify the functional-group change and assign the stereochemical descriptors in B's IUPAC name.
State the stereochemical rule for tracking the ring's spatial configuration when later substituent changes alter CIP priority assignments.
Apply CH3CH2CH=PPh3 to B and identify product C under the ring and stereochemical convention selected above.
Hydrogenate C with H2/Pd and identify final product D under the current ring and stereochemical interpretation.
Check D's descriptors while keeping its spatial configuration fixed and accounting for changes in substituent priority.
State the full name and stereochemical assignment of D.
